mapper.select: SELECT INSTANCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CHAT_ID, OUTCOME, WEBHOOK_URL, STATUS, ATTEMPTS, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT, LAST_ERROR, CLAIMED_BY, CLAIMED_UNTIL, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM WF_TERMINAL_EVENT_OUTBOX WHERE 1=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WF_TERMINAL_EVENT_OUTBOX (INSTANCE_ID, TENANT_ID, CHAT_ID, OUTCOME, WEBHOOK_URL, STATUS, ATTEMPTS, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT, LAST_ERROR, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{tenantId}, #{chatId}, #{outcome}, #{webhookUrl}, 'PENDING', 0, #{nextAttemptAt}, NULL, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE TENANT_ID=VALUES(TENANT_ID), CHAT_ID=VALUES(CHAT_ID), OUTCOME=VALUES(OUTCOME), WEBHOOK_URL=VALUES(WEBHOOK_URL), STATUS='PENDING', ATTEMPTS=0, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT=VALUES(NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT), LAST_ERROR=NULL, CLAIMED_BY=NULL, CLAIMED_UNTIL=NULL, UPDATED_AT=VALUES(UPDATED_AT)
mapper.select: SELECT INSTANCE_ID FROM WF_TERMINAL_EVENT_OUTBOX WHERE (STATUS='PENDING' AND NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT <= #{nextAttemptAt}) OR (STATUS='IN_PROGRESS' AND CLAIMED_UNTIL <= #{claimedUntil}) ORDER BY NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT INSTANCE_ID,TENANT_ID,CHAT_ID,OUTCOME,WEBHOOK_URL,ATTEMPTS,CLAIMED_BY FROM WF_TERMINAL_EVENT_OUTBOX WHERE STATUS='IN_PROGRESS' AND CLAIMED_BY=#{owner} AND INSTANCE_ID IN #{id} ORDER BY NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT ASC LIMIT #{limit}
